step1_figure.description: A fully cascoded operational transconductance amplifier with an NMOS differential input pair, cascoded PMOS current mirror active loads, cascoded NMOS current mirrors, and a 4-transistor cascoded NMOS tail current source.

transconductance.description: Effective transconductance of the OTA from differential input to short-circuit output current

equation.explanation: Transconductance relates differential input voltage to small-signal output current. For unity mirror ratio K = 1, gmOTA equals the transconductance of the input differential pair NMOS transistors.
equation.assumptions: Matched input pair (M1, M2), matched current mirrors with mirror ratio K = 1.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming tail current Iss ≈ 20 uA, so each input transistor M1, M2 carries ID ≈ 10 uA. With typical (W/L) ≈ 10 to 20, gmn = sqrt(2 * unCox * (W/L) * ID) = sqrt(2 * 270e-6 * 10 * 10e-6) ≈ 232 uA/V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard biasing provides 10 uA branch current; gmn scales with sqrt(ID * W/L).

equation.explanation: Low-frequency gain is determined by the input transconductance multiplied by the parallel output resistance of the NMOS and PMOS cascode branches.
equation.assumptions: Both NMOS and PMOS cascodes operate in active/saturation region with infinite load resistance (capacitive load only).

sky130_expected.calculation: For ID ≈ 10 uA: ro ≈ 1 / (lambda * ID) = 1 / (0.1 * 10u) = 1 MOhm. Cascode output resistance Rocas ≈ gm * ro^2. With gm ≈ 150 uA/V to 200 uA/V, Rocas ≈ 150e-6 * (1e6)^2 = 150 MOhm. Rout = Rocasn || Rocasp ≈ 75 MOhm. Av = gmn * Rout ≈ 200e-6 * 75e6 = 15,000 ≈ 83.5 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Cascode stages multiply transistor output impedance by intrinsic gain gm*ro, providing 60-90 dB of open-loop DC gain in SKY130.

dominant_pole_3dB_frequency.description: Open-loop 3-dB corner bandwidth set by the output resistance and load capacitor

equation.explanation: Because the cascode OTA has high impedance only at its output node, the dominant pole is formed by the parallel cascode output resistance and load capacitance CL.
equation.assumptions: Output node dominates frequency response; internal nodes are low impedance.

sky130_expected.calculation: Rout ≈ 75 MOhm, CL = 1 pF: f3dB = 1 / (2 * pi * 75e6 * 1e-12) ≈ 2.12 kHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Very high cascode output impedance with 1 pF load capacitance places the dominant pole in the low-kHz range.

unity_gain_frequency.description: Frequency where the open-loop voltage gain drops to 0 dB (gain-bandwidth product)

equation.explanation: The product of DC gain and 3-dB bandwidth yields the unity-gain frequency fun, which depends directly on input pair transconductance and load capacitor CL.
equation.assumptions: Single dominant-pole roll-off at 20 dB/decade until unity gain.

sky130_expected.calculation: With gmn ≈ 200 uA/V and CL = 1 pF: fun = 200e-6 / (2 * pi * 1e-12) ≈ 31.8 MHz (Baker textbook example gives ~24 MHz for gmn=150 uA/V).
sky130_expected.reasoning: For a 1 pF load and ~150-300 uA/V transconductance, unity-gain frequency falls squarely between 15 MHz and 60 MHz.

maximum_output_current.description: Maximum bidirectional current the OTA can source or sink into the load

equation.explanation: When driven with a large differential input, one half of the input pair steers the total tail current Iss into the mirror, producing K * Iss at the output.
equation.assumptions: Complete current steering in diff pair under large differential signal; K = 1.

sky130_expected.calculation: Total tail current Iss ≈ 20 uA. With K = 1, iout_max ≈ 20 uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The tail current source provides ~20 uA in nominal bias condition.

slew_rate.description: Large-signal rate of change of the output voltage limited by maximum charging current and load capacitance

source.reference: Text on page 798 regarding Iss driving CL

equation.explanation: The maximum rate at which the OTA can charge or discharge the load capacitor CL is limited by its available output current.
equation.assumptions: Slew rate determined by external capacitive load charging/discharging.

sky130_expected.reasoning: With 20 uA driving 1 pF load, maximum slewing speed is nominally 20 V/us.

equation.explanation: Total static power drawn from the 1.8V power supply by the OTA core and bias network.
equation.assumptions: Quiescent state with zero differential input.

sky130_expected.calculation: Core current is Iss + 2 * branch currents ≈ 20 uA + 2 * 10 uA = 40 uA. Bias circuit SUB_1 draws ~60-80 uA. Itotal ≈ 100-120 uA. Pdc = 1.8 V * 110 uA ≈ 200 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Biased at nominal current levels in SKY130 1.8V process.

step3_testbench.description: Comprehensive ngspice testbench simulating DC operating point, open-loop AC response with DC stability feedback network (Fig. 24.34), and large-signal transient slewing.
